context: A boss reviews a public-event budget
purpose: Teach: 引か/運ば/塗り/桁/タスク/パブリック/フィードバック/会費

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: パブリックイベントの予算、桁の見直しが必要だな。
lines.en: The public event budget figures need a closer look. We should review the numbers.
lines.style: Measured, direct. Slight pause before 'figures.' No performance—just the weight of expectation. Eyes level, shoulders steady.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。会費収入、想定通りに引かない可能性があります。
lines.en: Yes. The membership fee income might not come in as projected.
lines.style: Steady, thinking-aloud tone. Not defensive—just laying out the problem clearly. Slight forward lean. Quiet ownership in the delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: タスク分担、塗り重ねて整理してくれ。
lines.en: Break the task into layers. Get it organized and clean it up.
lines.style: Firmer now, more directive. Light emphasis on 'layers.' Not unkind—the tone of someone who knows what needs to happen next. Slight exhale after 'clean it up.'

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 承知しました。各部からフィードバックを集めて、運ばせます。
lines.en: Understood. I'll pull feedback from each department and move it forward.
lines.style: Assured, no hesitation. Respectful cadence. The tone of someone taking ownership. Slight nod in the voice at the end.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.style: Quiet, final. Just enough warmth to show this is trust, not pressure. A closing exhale. End of conversation.
